agent_functional_coverage_wave12.scope: Explicit station_profile=terminal_area, separate from unchanged strict default point_only. Ten SHA-bound sources including native Connection template. Single Engine reference with strict integer posInTrain=1/no trailer single-reference Engine.length<=area length (position is not quantity), named Course speed/run index/real directional Edge and Engine cap necessary leg bounds. Explicit same Train+Itinerary+actual directional endpoint chains, minimum420SECONDS (not minutes) and bounded one-day plan, no fork/merge/cycle/day-wrap. Native reciprocal Connection pair fields/tags/min/max and graph references independently checked. Optional generated run has exact one-day profile window and explicit root but is not terminal semantic acceptance. Fresh-only atomic no-replace output; rejection-only nofollow early existence check does not authorize writes or replace commit.
agent_functional_coverage_wave12.remaining: No native stopping completion/turnround activation, six physical vehicles, actual vehicle reuse, braking feasibility, dynamic conflict/deadlock/capacity, global runtime/default isolation or completed one-day simulation established. General multi-edge/platform/area geometry and mixed imported profiles outside finite supported domain. Real runtime validation remains paused.

current_archive_functions.scope: Bounded current data support only, not whole original requirement completion.

agent_functional_coverage_wave10.scope: Nine explicit SHA-bound sources, current schemas only, network generated in memory first. Ordinary pass/timing Station3/StationModel1/End bindings; oneEngine/noTrailer type templates with explicit physics+conflict acceptance, fresh names/owned mutable graphs. No globalpreferences edit or old macro/path inheritance.
agent_functional_coverage_wave10.remaining: Ordinary pass/timing Station bindings are supported, not platform/stopping extents. Vehicle physics is explicitly inherited proxy type data, not calibration; Train definitions are not verified physical fleet circulation. Pass-only/no dwell/unset actuals/no connection circulation. Minimal run does not fully isolate global runtime options; destination existence/runtime/license not verified. No native load, dynamics, conflict/deadlock/capacity or one-day simulation result.

agent_functional_coverage_wave11.scope: Both reciprocal halves of each selected logical StationVertex are exact End7, group12 points to the SAME actual existing StationModel1, group20=2. Reject connector, inconsistent pair, missing/ambiguous refs and unknown types. Traverse actual directional routes, remove only consecutive shared-boundary duplicates, preserve repeated laps. TT flags remain2: stop=false/timing=true; timing flag does not create geographic StationVertex.
agent_functional_coverage_wave11.remaining: Static saved-data contract only; no native simulation,720 actual passing logs,platform stops/length envelopes,physical fleet/circulation,full global runtime options or full-day result proven.
agent_functional_coverage_wave11.withdrawn_previous_claim: Wave10 ordinary Station-associated type1 OTEndModel is rejected by native isStationEndModel/handlePassedStations gate. Decoding and matching 720 TT rows did not prove native station passing semantics. This is a static semantic defect, not an observed native runtime failure.

agent_functional_coverage_wave12.scope: Explicit station_profile=terminal_area, separate from unchanged strict default point_only. Ten SHA-bound sources including native Connection template. New74DVG/92Edge network, six one-Edge500m areas with ordinary type1 members and paired type2 reference vertices; exactly five route-derived visits, only index4 stop=true; actual unset. Single Engine reference with strict integer posInTrain=1/no trailer single-reference Engine.length<=area length (position is not quantity), named Course speed/run index/real directional Edge and Engine cap necessary leg bounds. Explicit same Train+Itinerary+actual directional endpoint chains, minimum420SECONDS (not minutes) and bounded one-day plan, no fork/merge/cycle/day-wrap. Native reciprocal Connection pair fields/tags/min/max and graph references independently checked. Optional generated run has exact one-day profile window and explicit root but is not terminal semantic acceptance. Fresh-only atomic no-replace output; rejection-only nofollow early existence check does not authorize writes or replace commit.
agent_functional_coverage_wave12.remaining: No native stopping completion/turnround activation, six physical vehicles, actual vehicle reuse, braking feasibility, dynamic conflict/deadlock/capacity, global runtime/default isolation or completed one-day simulation established. General multi-edge/platform/area geometry and mixed imported profiles outside finite supported domain. Real runtime validation remains paused.

agent_functional_coverage_wave10.scope: Nine explicit SHA-bound sources, current schemas only, network generated in memory first. Ordinary pass/timing Station3/StationModel1/End bindings; oneEngine/noTrailer type templates with explicit physics+conflict acceptance, fresh names/owned mutable graphs. Explicit finite Course plans or bounded assignments/periods; true ordered station occurrences preserved, actuals unset, zero dwell, no Categoryforcedstop. Named Course speed resolves orderedTrainType→directionalEdge key and Enginevmax; each leg must meet necessary freeflow bound, not sufficient dynamic feasibility. Optional run_configuration builds literal windows/posix execution paths for all sixcatalogs/document/output, orderedTrainTypes and start/stop/Step, with exact text/hash validators and emptyoutput directory in the same fresh atomic transaction. No globalpreferences edit or old macro/path inheritance.
agent_functional_coverage_wave10.remaining: Ordinary pass/timing Station bindings are supported, not platform/stopping extents. Vehicle physics is explicitly inherited proxy type data, not calibration; Train definitions are not verified physical fleet circulation. Pass-only/no dwell/unset actuals/no connection circulation. Minimal run does not fully isolate global runtime options; destination existence/runtime/license not verified. No native load, dynamics, conflict/deadlock/capacity or one-day simulation result.

agent_functional_coverage_wave11.scope: Both reciprocal halves of each selected logical StationVertex are exact End7, group12 points to the SAME actual existing StationModel1, group20=2. Reject connector, inconsistent pair, missing/ambiguous refs and unknown types. Traverse actual directional routes, remove only consecutive shared-boundary duplicates, preserve repeated laps. TT flags remain2: stop=false/timing=true; timing flag does not create geographic StationVertex.
agent_functional_coverage_wave11.remaining: Static saved-data contract only; no native simulation,720 actual passing logs,platform stops/length envelopes,physical fleet/circulation,full global runtime options or full-day result proven.
agent_functional_coverage_wave11.withdrawn_previous_claim: Wave10 ordinary Station-associated type1 OTEndModel is rejected by native isStationEndModel/handlePassedStations gate. Decoding and matching 720 TT rows did not prove native station passing semantics. This is a static semantic defect, not an observed native runtime failure.

agent_functional_coverage_wave12.scope: Explicit station_profile=terminal_area, separate from unchanged strict default point_only. Ten SHA-bound sources including native Connection template. New74DVG/92Edge network, six one-Edge500m areas with ordinary type1 members and paired type2 reference vertices; exactly five route-derived visits, only index4 stop=true; actual unset. Single Engine reference with strict integer posInTrain=1/no trailer single-reference Engine.length<=area length (position is not quantity), named Course speed/run index/real directional Edge and Engine cap necessary leg bounds. Explicit same Train+Itinerary+actual directional endpoint chains, minimum420SECONDS (not minutes) and bounded one-day plan, no fork/merge/cycle/day-wrap. Native reciprocal Connection pair fields/tags/min/max and graph references independently checked. Optional generated run has exact one-day profile window and explicit root but is not terminal semantic acceptance. Fresh-only atomic no-replace output; rejection-only nofollow early existence check does not authorize writes or replace commit.
agent_functional_coverage_wave12.remaining: No native stopping completion/turnround activation, six physical vehicles, actual vehicle reuse, braking feasibility, dynamic conflict/deadlock/capacity, global runtime/default isolation or completed one-day simulation established. General multi-edge/platform/area geometry and mixed imported profiles outside finite supported domain. Real runtime validation remains paused.
